column3: Picks the best player of the month ratings with the requested age and records him as the month winner, with his club. \n `MONTH_AWARD::award_best_rated_player(ratings, age)`, called at the turn of the month by the nations' awards (England's at 0x579a37..0x579adc). It takes the best of the ratings (0x768130) in the award's league (`[+9]`, or −1) and with the requested age; when one is found, it records the winner (0x7671c0) with the person's club (+0x39, or −1), and the month (+0xc) and year (+0xd) of the ratings. The high bytes of the month and the year are passed exactly as the original pushes them (taken from the person table in the register).

Finds the month slot, stores the person and the club, raises the winner's reputation, sends the news and records the award in the history. \n `MONTH_AWARD::set_winner(person, club, month, year)`. It looks for the month's slot (12 slots of 11 bytes: month at +0x25, year at +0x26); without one, it does nothing. It stores the person (+0x1d) and the club (+0x21); when there is a person, it raises the award winner's reputation (0x412f00, with the award's reputations +0x15 and +0x17 and the player flag +0x19); then the news (0x767330) and the award record (0x86c8c0 on `[0xdd7f00]`, with the award's +5).

Sorts an array of clubs by strength (0x4c0720), strongest first. \n `comp_util_sort_clubs_by_strength(clubs, n)`: sorts the array of `n` clubs by strength (0x4c0720), highest first, keeping the keys in a temporary array (0x944e46 / 0x9452ca; the original fills it with 0x60 beforehand, all of which is overwritten). Out of memory: the error box (line 0x292d) and nothing else.

Finds or adds the club's record in the competition statistics and stores the position at +0x72. \n `Comp_Stats::set_club_final_position(club, position)`: finds (0x4a4850) or adds (0x4aceb0) the club's record in the competition statistics and stores the position (a byte) at +0x72; returns the record. Null club: the error box (line 0x680).

Returns the club's side in the fixture: 1 home, 2 away, 3 neutral, from the fixture's stadium and the two clubs' stadiums (national sides: by the stadium's nation). \n `comp_util_get_fixture_venue_side(club, fixture)`. Without a venue in the fixture (+0x18): by the home club (+0x1c), 3 if it has no stadium (+0x69), otherwise 1 for the home club and 2 for the other. National side (0x53b900): 1 if the venue's nation (+0x38, +0x1f) is the club's (+0x53), 2 if it is the opponent's, otherwise 3. Club: if the venue is the club's stadium and not the opponent's, 1; if it is both clubs' stadium, 1 for the home club and 2 for the other; if only the opponent's, 2; if neither's, 3. The caller reads only `al`.

The qsort order of the nation coefficients: highest first. \n `compare_nation_coefficients_desc(a, b)`: the qsort comparison (12 bytes per entry, the coefficient as a double at +4) used by game_update_nation_coefficients 0x5d6187 (on the day of the month from table 0x9cd200): higher first (−1); lower or unordered (NaN, the C0 flag of fcomp), 1; equal, 0. Hot (inside qsort): no counter. The original sorts the array and frees it right afterwards, so the order never reaches the game (only the comparison run notices it).

Sorts the clubs by reputation (nulls last) and shuffles the first min(3 × picks, n). \n `comp_util_sort_and_shuffle_top_clubs(clubs, n, picks)`: sorts the `n` clubs by reputation, highest first and nulls at the end (qsort 0x945333 with 0x4b07d0), and shuffles the first m = min(3 × picks, n) with m swaps of randomly drawn pairs among them. `n` negative or smaller than `picks`: the "Error" box (the original); `picks` < 1: nothing.

Classifies a league match between two clubs: 1 = title clash, 3 = zone clash, 0 = none, from the weighted statistics ratings (0x4a4850) against a third of the clubs or 0.2 × clubs + `+0xbe` (+ `+0xbf`). \n `comp_util_get_league_clash_type(a, b)`: both clubs must be in the same division (+0x57, neither reserve nor minor: 0x7e6f20), its league (`[0xadadfc][id]`) must have statistics (+8, 0x4a4850 for both), no stages (+0x30 = −1) and +0x43 = 2, and the difference in +0x73 must be at most a quarter of the clubs (+0x3e). With the ratings (league_stats_rating): 1 = title clash (virtual +0x98 = 0, both below a third of the clubs and each not below the other's +0x74); 3 = zone clash (+0x98 ≠ 0, both up to 0.2 × clubs + +0xbe, or, with +0xbf, up to 0.2 × clubs + +0xbe + +0xbf, and the same cross-check of +0x74); otherwise 0. Returns only `al`. No SEH, no random draw; the virtual +0x98 is called up to three times, as in the original.

Computes a club's strength score: money (+0x65 / 400 or balance / 300) + 16 × reputation + the off-match ratings (0x6e6340) of the 15 picked (0x6e2000) from the squad; null club: −10,000,000. \n `comp_util_get_club_strength_score(club)`: the money (without the finance table `[0xae2a38]`: +0x65 / 400; with it, the 64-bit balance / 300 via 0x5a0590), plus 16 × the reputation (+0x80), plus the off-match rating (0x6e6340, 0x840, limit −1) of the 15 picked players (0x6e2000, codes 1, 0x804, 0x84, 3 × 0x204, 0x810, 0x90, 3 × 0x210, 4 × 0x40) among the players (+0x61) of the squad (0x541f90). Null club: −10,000,000. No SEH, no random draw of its own. The original pushes the number of players as a dword with only the low byte written (the rest is stack leftover); 0x6e2000 reads only the byte, and the copy passes the byte zero-extended.

Sorts the competition history and returns the winner, runner-up or third (+0xa, +0xe, +0x12) from the competition's first row; not found: 0. \n `comp_util_get_latest_placed_club(comp, place)`: sorts the competition history (qsort 0x945333 with 0x540780), searches (bsearch 0x946464) for the competition with year −1 (any), walks back to its first row and returns the club in `place` (0 winner +0xa, 1 runner-up +0xe, 2 third +0x12); not found: 0. Any other place: the original (the comp_util.cpp error box). The key on the original's stack has only +4 and +8 written, and 0x540780 reads only those two; the copy zeroes the rest.

Rebuilds the fixture from eighteen consecutive news slots and resolves its clubs, stadium and competition. \n The fixture (`partida`) is rebuilt from 18 consecutive slots of the `noticia` (news item, 0x785830) starting at `*cursor` (which advances by 18): +0xc and +0x10 the clubs, +0x3d, +0x3e, +4 the stadium, +0 the competition, +0x42, +0x32, +0x30, +0x43/+0x44, +0x4b/+0x4c and +0x47/+0x48 the scores, +0x2a, +0x28 and +8. Then the pointers: clubs (0xae23b4, 0x245 bytes) at +0x1c/+0x20, stadium (0xae23b0, 0x4e) at +0x18 and competition (0xae23d0, 0x6b) at +0x14; id −1: 0.

Classifies the cup tie result for the club, from the final margin, the side and the reputation gap. \n The category (1 to 7) of the tie result for the `clube` (club) in the `partida` (fixture): the final margin (score +0x4b/+0x4c, or +0x47/+0x48, or +0x43/+0x44, the first one without 0xff) from the club's side (home = +0x1c) and the clubs' reputations (+0x80 / 500). 1 thrashing, 2 and 3 wins against stronger sides, 4 ordinary, 5 and 7 defeats to weaker sides, 6 upset. Only `al` is faithful (the caller uses `al`).

Writes the fixture's clubs, venue, competition, score and round into 18 consecutive news slots and advances the cursor. \n The community map gives the 2nd argument as unused, but it is the news item. Writes the fixture into 18 consecutive data slots of the news item (0x785790), starting at slot `[cursor]`, and advances the cursor by 18. Order: +0xc, +0x10, +0x3d, +0x3e, +4, +0, +0x42, +0x32, +0x30, +0x43, +0x44, +0x4b, +0x4c, +0x47, +0x48, +0x2a, +0x28, +8 (bytes and the words +0x30/+0x32 signed; +0x28 and +0x2a unsigned). Returns what the last write returned. The original keeps the index of the 18th slot in the low byte of the `cursor` argument itself (only the low part reaches 0x785790).

Writes the stage and round names (with their genders, through template 0x9a7cfc), or just one of them; without an output or under 200 bytes, the error box and 0. \n `comp_util_format_stage_round_name(stage, round, output, size, style)`: without an output or with fewer than 200 bytes, the error box (line 0x26a1) and 0. Clears the output; with both stage and round, "{stage} {round}" (0x66f4e0 with template 0x9a7cfc, the 100-byte names from 0x4b4850 and the genders from 0x4ba8f0); with only one of them, its name directly in the output (0x4b4850 with the size); with neither, just the zero. Returns 1 (0 on the error box).

Returns the round's value between two limits: the average with a single round, otherwise (high − low) × round / (rounds − 1); outside 0..100, the error box. \n `comp_util_scale_by_round(low, high, round, rounds)` (signed bytes and words; the words arrive in registers with garbage above them and only the word is read): with a single round, the average (low + high) / 2; otherwise (high − low) × round / (rounds − 1). Outside 0..=100: the original (error box at line 0x256e, returns 0 or 100). Returns the original's whole eax (the caller pushes the whole register to 0x86bdd0/0x86c000): the byte in `al` over the sum (single round) or the quotient.

Stores competition, year and four values in the free row of the competition history (without one, grows by 20 rows through 0x527f60); returns the row. \n `comp_util_add_history_record(league, first, second, third, extra)`: the free row of the competition history (without one, it grows by 20 rows through 0x527f60 and uses the first new one; out of memory, 0) receives the competition (the league's +4), the year `[0xae2c92]` (+8), and the four values at +0xa, +0xe, +0x12, +0x16. Returns the row. No SEH, no random draw, no locals.

Returns the group (the containing stage) of a stage or round by id, from fixed ranges; −1 without a group. \n `comp_util_get_parent_stage_id(id)`: 0x3e8..0x3fb, 0x41f..0x42e, 0x413, 0x414, 0x47b and 0x3fc -> 0x41c; 0x473..0x474 -> 0x410; 0x475..0x479 -> 0x47a; 0x3fd..0x406 -> 0xa; 0x407..0x40b and 0x472 -> 0x14; 0x47e..0x47f -> 0x1e; 0x40c..0x40e -> 0x82; 0x43d..0x444 -> 0x449; 0x445..0x448 -> 0x44a; 0x44d..0x450 -> 0x451; everything else −1 (in the original's test order).

Draws the Champions League first group phase: the 32 clubs sorted by pot, same-nation partners in opposite halves, the draw of the 8 groups pot by pot, the swap of same-nation clubs within a group, the coefficient, the 1,800,000 prize and its news, the 8 stages, and the third qualifying round losers into the UEFA Cup. 
 SEH frame only for the stage's `new`: no destructor on the normal path. `EuropeanCup::draw_phase1_groups()`, called from the Champions League's next-stage routine (0x5851d0, stage 0). 
 1) The list of the 32 (0x945501(0x20, 9): push 9; push 0x20; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; 9 bytes: +0 the club, +4 the same-nation partner, +8 the half: 1 groups A..D, 2 groups E..H; out of memory, the error box at line 0x4cc): the first 16 of table `[+0x14]` (6 bytes) and the teams of table `[+0xa7]` (6 bytes) with +5 = 1 (the third qualifying round winners). Fewer than 32: the error box at line 0x4ee, +0x30 = −1, the list freed and +0xb1 = 0. 
 2) The list is sorted by pot (qsort 0x945333 with 0x586f60: the club's +0x1df and the reputation) and each club without a partner gets the first following club without a partner from the same nation (the two point at each other). 
 3) The groups (0x945501(0x20, 4): 8 groups × 4 pots; out of memory, the error box at line 0x515 and the game stops): for each pot of 8 (k = 0..3), 4 slots start free in each half, minus those already marked; 8 times a club of the pot is drawn (0x90cfc0(8) + 8k, drawn again while the slot is already taken); without a half, one is drawn (0x90cfc0(free A + free B) < free B: the second) and the partner, if it is in the same pot, is put in the other half (with no slot there, it is not marked); the club enters the first group of the half with the pot free. 
 4) In each half and pot, a club with another club of the same nation in its group swaps places with the same-pot club of the first other group in the half without its nation. 
 5) Each group: the 4 clubs earn 1 point of the nation coefficient (0x9058b0 on `[0xde1f58]`: push 1; push nation -> thiscall, ret 8), the 1,800,000 prize (0x5a0590 on `[0xae2a38]` push club -> thiscall, ret 4; 0x5999a0 push amount; mov ecx, finances -> thiscall, ret 4) and the prize news (0x48e3e0: push −2; push 0; push 0x449; push −1; push 0; push amount; push club; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x1c); the round table from method +0x3c (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push g; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (0x944cf1(0xee) and the League_Stage constructor 0x68b100: this, 4, the group, 2, +4, the table, the rounds (word), 3, 1, 8, &{4,1,2,0}, &{2,0,0,0}, the year (word), g, the id (word), 0xf, 2, 0, 8, −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the year with garbage in the high bytes of edx, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes the clean year) into `[+0xc][g]` (without a stage, the error box at line 0x5c9 and it returns, without freeing the table or the groups); the round table freed, +0x30 = g and the group news (0x684230). 
 6) The groups are freed; the teams of +0xa7 with +5 = 2 (the third qualifying round losers) go to the UEFA Cup (`[[0xadadfc] + 4 × [0x9cf6f0]]`; without it, the error box at line 0x5d8): into the last 24 slots of its +0xa7 table (from +0x3e − 24), with +4 and +5 cleared, into its +0x14 table with status 5 (+0x36 goes up) and with the club's European competition (+0x1db) = `[0x9cf6f0]`; then the UEFA Cup's predicted positions (its method +0x5c).

Sets the Champions League predicted positions: the entrants sorted by strength, each one's predicted position taken from the knockout from the final back, the second and first group phases and the qualifying rounds. \n Method +0x5c of the Champions League: `EuropeanCup::rank_teams()`. Without statistics (+8): the error box at line 0x81b. The entrants of table `[+0x14]` (6 bytes, +0x36 of them) go into an array (0x944e46; out of memory, the error box at line 0x823), sorted by strength (0x4c08f0: push n; push array; add esp, 8 -> cdecl); the knockout table from method +0x3c (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push 0xc; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0x10), freed afterwards; each entrant's position, in array order, through 0x4a2540 (push position; push club; mov ecx, `[+8]` -> thiscall, ret 8; the original pushes the stack dword with the position in the low byte and garbage in the others, and 0x4a2540 writes only the byte: the copy passes the clean byte) following the plan in `planned_final_positions`; the array freed.

Draws the Champions League second group phase: the 16 qualifiers sorted, the same-group pairs, each one's group choice (shuffled order, fewest teams, no same first-phase group nor nation), the redraw up to 20 times, the coefficient, the 1,200,000 prize and its news, stages 8 to 11 and the third places into the UEFA Cup. 
 SEH frame only for the stage's `new`: no destructor on the normal path. `EuropeanCup::draw_phase2_groups(attempt)`, called from the Champions League's next-stage routine (0x5851d0, stage 8, attempt 0). 
 1) The 16 qualifiers (0x945501(0x10, 7); out of memory, the error box at line 0x61c): from each first-phase group b (`[+0xc][b]`) the first and second of the table (0x6826d0 push 0 / push 1; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4), with group b and 0/1; +4 counts the clubs in the list from the same nation (itself included); the list is sorted (qsort 0x945333 with 0x5871e0) and each club's bookings are cleared in the competition's governing body (0x7e9180, as in the World Cup draw). 
 2) The pairs from the same first-phase group (two cleared lists of 16; out of memory, the error boxes 0x649 and 0x651): each club still in the list goes to slot k (winner) or k + 1 (runner-up) and the other club of its group to the other one; k goes up by 2. 
 3) Each of the 16, in pair order: the order of the 4 groups is shuffled (5 swaps of 0x90cfc0(4) and 0x90cfc0(4)); the group with fewest teams among those that have a free slot in its half (winners in slots 0/1, runners-up in 2/3) and have no team from the same first-phase group nor from the same nation receives the club. 
 4) If a club is left without a group: with attempt < 20, the lists are freed and the draw is run again with attempt + 1 (the call nests inside this one); on the 20th, each leftover takes the first free slot (the club stays in the pairs list). 
 5) Each group h (0..3): the 4 clubs earn 1 coefficient point, the 1,200,000 prize and the news (0x48e3e0 with round 0x44a); stage h + 8 (method +0x3c, 0x944cf1(0xee) and the constructor 0x68b100 with the same arguments as the first-phase draw, the list of the 4 clubs copied into a 0x40-byte array (0x944e46); without a stage, the error box at line 0x715), +0x30 = h + 8 and the group news. The four lists are freed. 
 6) The first-phase third places (0x6826d0 push 2) go to the UEFA Cup (`[[0xadadfc] + 4 × [0x9cf6f0]]`; without it, the error box at line 0x729): into the last 8 slots of its +0xa7 table, from back to front, into the +0x14 table with status 5 and with the club's European competition = the UEFA Cup; the fourth places (push 3) are left without a European competition (−1); then the UEFA Cup's predicted positions (method +0x5c).

The comparison for the second-phase qualifiers: more same-nation clubs first, then the higher nation word +0x8e, then the group winner before the runner-up. \n `european_cup_compare_phase2_draw_entries(a, b)`, the qsort comparison of the qualifiers (0x585ab0): b's same-nation count (+4) minus a's; on a tie: the nation's word +0x8e (the club's +0x53) of b minus a's; on a tie: a's +6 (the runner-up flag) minus b's.

Updates the staff records by outcome and stage: in qualifying, the qualified (0x86bdd0) or knocked-out (0x86c000) record weighted by round (0x4bf850); in the group stages, qualified (6) or failed to qualify (0xfe, 0x86c1d0); in the knockout, winners (0x86a800), runners-up (0x86b0b0), qualified or knocked out; whoever leaves gets +0x1db = -1; returns 0. 
 `EuropeanCup::update_staff_records_for_status(club, outcome, stage, _, fixture, final)`, the Champions League's virtual +0x44. Returns 0. Comp = +4. 
 - In qualifying (stage 0xff): outcome 0 or 1, the qualification by the fixture's round (+0x34): in round 0, with stage +0x3a and the +0x6f of the first round (+0xa3) and the weight 0x4bf850(1, 0x14, 0, 2); in any other, 0x41c, 0 and 0x4bf850(1, 0x14, round, 2). Outcome 0xff or 2: the elimination (0x86c000) with the fixture's +0x32 and +0x30 and the weight 0x4bf850(1, 0x14, round, 2), and the club leaves (+0x1db = −1). 
 - In phase 1 (stage < 8): 6, the qualification (0x44a, −1, 0x32); 0xfe, the non-qualification (0x449, 0x32) and the club leaves. 
 - In phase 2 (8 to 11): 6, the qualification (0, 0x78, 0x32); 0xfe, the non-qualification (0x44a, 0x32) and the club leaves. 
 - In the knockout (12): 1, the title (Staff_Records::add_cup_winners_record 0x86a800, thiscall(records, club, fixture, final), ret 0xc) and the club leaves; 2, runner-up (0x86b0b0, likewise) and the club leaves; 0, the qualification (0, the +0x6f of the fixture's round in the knockout stage's round table (`[+0xc]` + 0x30, +0xa3, 0x68 bytes), 0x4bf850(0x4b, 0x64, round, 2)); 0xff, the elimination (0, the fixture's +0x30, 0x4bf850(0x4b, 0x64, round, 2)) and the club leaves.

Draws the order of the 4 phase 2 groups (0x90cfc0) and pairs the quarter-finals (1st of a v 2nd of b, 2nd of a v 1st of b, same for c and d), resets the 8 clubs' bookings (0x7e9180), creates the knockout stage (0x522e00) in slot +0x30, drops the 3rd and 4th of each group (+0x1db = -1), sets up the round (0x51c800) and sets +0x30 = 12. \n `EuropeanCup::draw_quarter_finals()`, called from the next-stage routine 0x5851d0 at stage 12. Each one goes through 0x7e9180 (thiscall(the object `[[0xae28f0]]` + 4 × +0x50, club), ret 4). The virtual +0x3c (create_round_table: stage 12) and the knockout stage (operator new 0x944cf1 of 0xb2; Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage 0x522e00 with the cup, 8, the list, the rounds, +4, the table, +0x40, 0xc, 2, the extra, 0x14, 1, 0, 0, 0) into slot `[+0xc]` + 0x30; the list and the table freed (0x9452ca). Without a stage: the error box at line 0x78a. Otherwise the 3rd and 4th of each phase 2 group leave (+0x1db = −1), the round is set up (Cup::set_up_round 0x51c800, thiscall(stage, 0)) and +0x30 = 12.

Allocates the list (0x11c bytes) of the entrants (+0x14) still in the cup (+0x1db = its id): kind 1 without the round 7 entries, kind 2 all, kind 3 at stage 11; otherwise the competition's own (0x48e1c0); returns the count. \n `EuropeanCup::collect_club_list(&list, kind)`, the Champions League's virtual +0x58. Kind 1: the entrants still in, except those of round 7; kind 2: all those still in; kind 3 at stage 11: those still in; in any other case the competition's one (Comp::collect_club_list 0x48e1c0, thiscall(this, &list, 0), ret 8). The list (malloc 0x944e46 of 0x11c bytes; out of memory: the error box at line 0x7b5, 0x7cf or 0x7e9, null list and 0) goes into `list`; returns the count in the low word (the high word is the list pointer's).

Moves to the next stage (+0x30) and draws the phase 1 groups (stage 0), the phase 2 groups (8) or the quarter-finals (12); at the last stage, the error box. \n `EuropeanCup::advance_stage()` (the virtual +0x28, from the cup pass 0x51f904). At the last stage (+0x30 ≥ +0x2c − 1, signed): the error box at line 0x495. Otherwise +0x30 + 1 and, at stage 0, the phase 1 group draw (0x585290, thiscall(this)); at 8, the phase 2 draw (0x585ab0, thiscall(this, 0), ret 4); at 12, the quarter-finals (0x586330, thiscall(this)). The caller does not read the return value.

Converts the three progress codes by stage (qualifying, phase 1, phase 2) and writes them to +0x73..+0x75 of the club's competition stats entry. \n `EuropeanCup::set_club_progress(club, stage, p1, p2, p3)` (the virtual +0x68, from the cup base 0x521b30): converts the three progress codes by stage and writes them into the club's record in the competition statistics (0x4a4850 on +8, without checking for null, as the original) +0x73 ← p1, +0x74 ← p2, +0x75 ← p3. Builds the round table: in the group stages, the 6-round schedule (phase 1 dates in September and October and phase 2 from November to March, by half) with fixture 0 of each round empty; the qualifying rounds and the knockout stay with the original. \n Method +0x3c of the Champions League, SEH frame for the local dates with no destructor on the normal path: `EuropeanCup::create_round_table(stage, &rounds, &id, &is_league)`, called from the group draws (0x585290, 0x585ab0) and the predicted positions (0x586900). The qualifying rounds (−1) and the knockout (12 onwards): the original through the trampoline. Returns the table.
