Adds the amount to the prize money of the month (+0xa8) and of the year (+0x148) and to the balance. \n `Finance::add_prize_money(amount)`, called from the cups (Cup::process_fixture 0x51a150, EuropeanCup::process_fixture 0x583b10, the stage draws), the end of the leagues (League::pay_prize_money 0x682e10) and the season honours: adds the amount to the prize money of the year (+0x148) and of the month (+0xa8) and to the balance.

Adds the amount to the TV income of the month (+0xb8) and of the year (+0x158) and to the balance. \n `Finance::add_tv_revenue(amount)`, called only from the league TV rights (League::pay_tv_rights 0x683010, when each league's table is built for the new season): adds the amount to the TV income of the year (+0x158) and of the month (+0xb8) and to the balance.

Adds the weekly merchandising income: attendance × reputation × factor (by the stadium of the +0xbf club or by reputation; Japan one step up), × (random(11) + 95)%, added to +0xbc, +0x15c and the balance. \n `FinanceTable::add_weekly_merchandising_income(club)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on day 6 of the week, league clubs). The base: with the +0xbf club and its stadium (+0x69), the level (+0xf) × 25 + the reputation (+0x80), × 0.65 truncated if byte +0x6d is zero, picks the factor by 5500 and 4000; without them, the reputation picks it by 5250 and 3750 (one step higher in the nation of Japan 0x9cf36c). Attendance (+0x73) × reputation × factor, truncated; × (random(11) + 95) × 0.01, truncated, added to +0xbc, +0x15c and the balance.

Sells season tickets: stadium of at least 1500 places; demand by the manager-table value, attendance and reputation, up to 87.5% of the places; new holders by the step fraction (+0x164) and a random draw; ratio at +0x160; income (with apply) by price, nation type and key clubs; the shop with two random draws by reputation. \n `Finance::sell_season_tickets(apply)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on day 6 of the week, when finance_get_days_to_season_start 0x59b4c0 says the season is still to start). The club by id (+8, 0x245-byte record); a stadium (+0x69) with fewer than 1500 places (+0x3c) uses reputation × 2.5 (minimum 1500). The demand: the club's value in the managers' manager (`[[0xb67a44]]` + 73·id + 8) × 0.0001 (minimum 0.15) × attendance (+0x73), × reputation × 0.00025 (minimum 0.5), capped at 87.5% of the places (1250 without a stadium). Above those already sold (+0x18): the step (+0x164, up to 8) picks the fraction (0x9c8758) of the difference, × (random(11) + 95) / 100 = the new ones; the sold/places ratio goes to +0x160 (f32, up to 0.875). The income (price by reputation × new ones; /4 or /10 by the nation type +0x7e; × 1.25 in Serie A, Chelsea 1.5, Arsenal and Tottenham 1.3, Everton 0.75, Liverpool 0.9, Germany 1.2) is applied only with `apply`; then (random(rep) + random(rep) + 1) × 0.001 + 1, × new ones, into +0x15c.

Raises the training facilities level (+0x7f) by reputation (up to 20); each step charges the works to +0x8c, +0x12c and the balance. \n `FinanceTable::upgrade_training_facilities(club)`, called from the club's season end (0x59cfa0, with the training request approved by the board). The level (+0x7f) goes up by 2 (1 from 19) and charges level × 50000 + 75000. Then, below 20: with reputation (+0x80) above 8250, it goes to 20 and charges (22 − level) × 250000 (minimum 2 million); below 14 with reputation above 5250, it goes up by 4 (minimum 16) and charges 3.5 million − level × 150000 (minimum 1 million); below 16 with reputation above 4250, or below 20 with reputation above 7250: above 7250 it goes to 20, otherwise up by 2 (minimum 12), and charges the new level × 50000 + 75000. Ceiling 20.

Processes the club's finance events by the finance band: ends or opens the crisis (+0x165), moves the squeeze counter (+0x166), tries the boost, the debt, the injection and the board takeover, wears the training ground; with squeeze above 50, removes the heating or closes 10% of the places. \n `FinanceTable::process_club_finance_events(club, week)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0: at the turn of the week with week = 1 for every league club with reputation 5000 or an active nation; on other days only for the club in crisis, with week = random zero). The club's finances (from partner A, 0x540a50) and the band (0x5986b0): 2 and 1 (rich) and 0 end the crisis (+0x165) and lower the squeeze counter (+0x166) to 5/0/10; 1 and 0 try the boost (0x59e050), the debt (0x59dd40) and the injection (0x59e5a0); −1 sets state 2, raises the squeeze by byte +0x6d, wears the training facilities and tries the debt, the injection and the board takeover (0x59e940); −2 enters the crisis (news 0x59fc60, clears flag +0x82, and at the human club 0x600a50 lowers the value of the squad contracts through 0x4d0c60, setting bit 4 of +0x4e) or, already in crisis, tries the takeover, the injection and the boost, wears the facilities and raises the squeeze by 3. Then, with an active league (`[0xadadfc]`) and squeeze above 50: removes the heating (+0x4d, 0x59ffb0) of a club with reputation below 4250, or closes 10% of the places (+0x3c to +0x44, 0x59f900, squeeze 20); the training facilities drop by random draw.

Tries a board payment of a poor club's debt (band −2/−1, or 0 with a low balance): after three random draws, the board pays 450, 300 or 150 × reputation and sends the news. \n `FinanceTable::try_board_debt_payment(club, finances)`, called from the events pass (0x59ed70). Band (0x5986b0) −2, −1 (divisor 2, or 0.4 with reputation of 3500), or 0 with reputation up to 3500 and a balance below 25 × reputation (0.4); the others: 0. random(7000) + 3500 above the reputation; random(6 / divisor) zero; random(level +0x20 of the stadium of the +0xbf club, or 10) not zero. The board pays 450 × reputation (below 1250 with a balance below −450 × reputation), 300 × (balance below −300 × reputation) or 150 ×: into +0x154, +0xb4 and the balance; the news (0x59f300, type 4); returns 1.

Tries a cash injection for a club of reputation 4750 outside Wales and the Irelands: random draws by the band and the stadium of the +0xbf club; the amount by reputation, up to 10% of the debt and 4 million; news and end of the crisis. \n `FinanceTable::try_cash_injection(club, finances)`, called from the events pass (0x59ed70). Reputation (+0x80) of 4750, without flag +0x82, outside Wales and the Irelands. Divisor by the band (−2: 0.25; −1: 0.1; others: 0.001). With the stadium of the +0xbf club: random(30 / divisor) below the level (+0xf) and level +0x20 above random(5) + 10: (20 × level + 150) × reputation + 750000; without it: random(4 / divisor) zero: (5 × reputation + 15000) × 50. Debt above 10 × the amount: 10% of the debt. Ceiling: reputation² + 1.5 million below 2000; otherwise 4 million (+1 if the amount exceeds reputation² / 4). Into +0x154, +0xb4 and the balance; the news (0x59f300, type 3, with the budget 0x598800); ends the crisis (+0x165 = 0); returns 1.

Returns the highest weekly wage the club offers a staff member for a job: default by job, nation level (+0x85) / type, key nation adjustments, league weight × 0.2, finance band, club ceiling (+0x14) and job range. \n `Finance::get_max_staff_wage(job)`, used by renewal (0x4cda70), interest in the job (0x844780) and the contract screens. Club by id (+8); type 3 (+0x64): 0. The default by job (5 to 7: 35000; 8: 20000; 9: 1500; 10: 1000; others: 750); national team (0x53b900): the default. Without a nation (+0x53): default × 0.25. With a nation: the level (+0x85) / (20 × type +0x7e between 1 and 3) × default; in type 1, England, Italy and Spain × 1.05 with reputation above 7250, Japan nothing, USA above 1750 with 0.75 of the excess, and the other groups with the excess above 2500/1250/750 by the factor (0.75/0.75/0.3, or reputation/50 / level × 0.1 × it, up to 1); with a league (+0x57), × the league weight (+0x69) × 0.2. By the finance band (0x5986b0): −2 × 0.75, −1 × 0.95, 1 × 1.5, 2 × 2. Limited to the club's ceiling (+0x14) and to the job's range.

Adds the amount to the bonus expenses (+0x138 and +0x98) and takes it from the balance. \n `Finance::pay_bonuses(amount)`, called from the contracts' end of match (CONTRACT_MANAGER::update_after_match 0x4ca6d0, three calls): adds the amount to the bonus expenses (+0x138 and +0x98) and subtracts it from the balance (i64 at +0, sign-extended).

Returns the club's wealth band: national team, 0; by the 64-bit balance against the club reputation R: above 2500·R + 5,000,000, 2; above 1000·R + 3,500,000, 1; below −2,500,000 − 1500·R, −2; below −250·R (R < 5000) or (3750 − R)·1000, −1; otherwise 0. \n `Finance::get_wealth_band()`, the band of the club's (+8, array 0xae23b4) balance (64 bits at +0/+4) by the reputation R (+0x80), used by transfers, the board, the managers, the finances and the postponement. National team (0x53b900): 0. Above 2500·R + 5,000,000: 2; above 1000·R + 3,500,000: 1; below −2,500,000 − 1500·R: −2; below −250·R (R < 5000) or (3750 − R)·1000 (R ≥ 5000): −1; otherwise 0.

Posts the news of a fined player's reaction: for a player under contract at a human club, news 0xbc6 with reason, reaction, random(2), personality, period, contract type, future transfer and effects. \n SEH frame for the local news item, no destructor. `post_fine_reaction_news(player, reason, reaction, period, effects)`, called from the fine (0x5a5980, five calls). No player, no contract (0x4cf5a0, on `[0xae1080]`), no club of his or no club contract (0x4cf5f0): nothing; player of a club (+0x39) without a human (0x7875e0): nothing. News 0xbc6 to the contract's club: the player (id and keys), reason, reaction, random(2), the personality (+0x5d + +0x5b below 12, +0x59 below 6 and reputation +0xb above 5250), period 1, the type 7 contract (+0x4f), the future transfer (0x8cca10), the effects and the game by the type (+0x4f 1 with more than 23 years, or 2).

Posts the coach's feedback on a fine: with player and coach both having a record and a nation, and the player having a club, news 0x1394 with the outcome and random(5). \n SEH frame for the local news item, no destructor. `post_coach_fine_feedback_news(player, coach, outcome)`, called from the fines' daily pass (0x5a5820: the feedback marked as due, more than 30 days at the club and no serious injury; the original leaves the Fine in ecx). Both with a record (+0x61) and a nation (+0x1a), the player with a club (+0x39): news 0x1394 (the player and the coach, id and keys; the outcome; random(5)) to the player's club.

Returns 1 on days 0, 80, 173 and 250 of the year (the retirement scan days), otherwise 0. \n `is_player_regen_day(day)`: 1 on days 0, 80, 173 and 250 of the year (the retirement search), otherwise 0. Called from the game's day loop (0x5cda97, with the whole date: the day is the low word). The original returns only `al` (`ah` keeps the day's high byte).

Returns the sum of two signed bytes clamped between the given minimum and maximum. \n `clamp_char_sum(a, b, min, max)`: the sum of the two signed bytes (16 bits), clamped between the other two. Returns the original's `ax`: `min` or `max` extended, or the high byte of `max` extended with the sum in `al` (the 26 callers, in the players' daily pass, write only `al`).

Updates the relationships in the squads: ten random pairs of team-mates: a disliked one stops being disliked and may fight (0x5888a0); otherwise becomes disliked, liked or stops being liked; every 50 days, random clubs go through the dressing room friction; on the other days each player, by attribute draws, may reach friction with the manager. \n `game_update_squad_relationships()`, every day from the game's day loop. (1) Ten times: a random club and two random squad slots (50); different people and random(the first one's +0x5b) = 0: if the first dislikes the second, he stops disliking him (0x547c50) and, at the same contract club and with the link flagged in +0x45 & 0x800, the fight (0x5888a0); otherwise, 1/3 start disliking (0x547af0), 1/3 of the rest start liking (0x547a10) and the rest stop liking (0x547c10). (2) Day a multiple of 50: `[0xae235c]`/100 random clubs go through the dressing room friction (0x5d7190). On the other days, each person (except the last 17) with a player record and preferences, a contract and the club's link with the +0xff person: three random draws (+0x5b, +0x5d, +0x5a, each + 5) filter; the sum of five attributes minus 3, 5, 15, 15 by draws that came out zero and 5 if the player's reputation (+0xb) exceeds 4500 and the club's (+0x80) gives the draw that, when zero, leads to friction with the manager.

Spreads morale through the squads by leadership: one club in seven each day (not national teams): the squad's leadership and leadership × morale are summed; each player draws from them and his own morale, and his morale goes up or down by one (0x544710). \n `game_spread_squad_morale_by_leadership()`, every day from the game's day loop. Each club that is not a national team (0x53b900), with random(7) = 0: sums the leadership (player +0x2f) and leadership × morale of the link (+0x44) over the squad (+0xd7, 50 slots); fewer than 16 players count 10 for each one missing. With a non-zero sum, each player draws (2 × Σ leadership × morale) / (his leadership + sum) plus random(morale / 12), as a signed byte: negative, random(s) < random(−5) lowers the morale (0x544710 with −1); positive, random(s) > random(5) raises it (+1).

Checks players missing training: n/250 consecutive people from a random one; a present player with training and without a serious injury misses training (0x41a360) by a random draw on the sum of attributes, morale and liking of the manager (more likely when newly arrived) or by the contract flags. \n `game_check_players_missing_training()`, every day from the game's day loop. Starting from a random person (random(n − n/250 − 1)), n/250 consecutive people: a player (+0x61, function +0x3d = 11) with a contract and a club, present (0x418f60), with the training record (0x8b39f0, +0x15) and without a serious injury (0x62c400 ≠ 2). (1) With +0x5b < 8, player +0x2f < 8 and the sum (player +0x2f, +0x18, +0x5b, link +0x44, −5 if +0x5b or the morale are 1, −5 if he dislikes the manager, +2 if he likes him) < 43: random(+0x5b + 100, 50 or 25 depending on the days since +0x3e: < 30, < 90, < 180) coming out zero is a miss. (2) Otherwise, with +0x5b < 10 and a link with the club: the link flags (+0x45: 0x8000, 0x30000; with +0x5b < 5, 0x7800) give random(+0x5b) draws that, when zero, are a miss. The miss: 0x41a360.

Gives the day to each competition in the list (virtual +0x14 with the game date and the flag); with the flag, the next step of `[0xae2a58]` (0x5aaf00). \n `game_update_comps_for_date(flag)`: each competition in the list (`[0xadadfc]`, count `[0xadadf8]` re-read on each iteration) receives the day (virtual +0x14 with the game date 0xae2c90 and the flag); with the flag, the next step of `[0xae2a58]` (0x5aaf00, which the original calls as a tail jump). Called from the game's day loop (with 1).

Adds the delta to the board's confidence in the club (+6 of the 73-byte club row), held to 1..10000. \n `manager_manager_adjust_board_confidence(club, delta)`: adds `delta` (word) to the board's confidence in the club (+6 of the MANAGER_MANAGER row `[0xb67a44]`), clamped to 1..10000. Null club: nothing. Called from the game's day loop (with −5).

Writes the region name (1..14): from the language 4, 5 and 9 tables with the adjective form, otherwise the translated adjective or noun by form. \n `get_region_name(region, text, size, form)`: clears the text and writes the name of the region (1..14, signed byte). Form (byte) other than 0xff with language (0x66f4d0) 4, 5 or 9: the text from the language's table, read by address (`[0x9d0518 + 4 × (4 × region + f)]`, `[0x9d06d4 + 4 × (5 × region + f)]`, `[0x9d05f8 + 4 × (4 × region + f)]`, with f the adjective form from 0x545a60, already in Rust, called through the game's address), copied. Otherwise, through 0x66f4e0: in languages 2, 4, 5 and 9 the adjective with form 0xff and the noun with the others; in the rest the opposite; the Caribbean: "Caribbean" in languages 2, 4, 5 and 9, otherwise the region texts (form 0xff) or regionality texts, with the empty string 0xad9c64. Returns 1. Null text, region out of range or size (signed short) < 100: the original (error box). Used in the region order (0x545dc0, in Rust), in the player search (player_search, search_screens) and in screens without a module (0x7db360, 0x7e13d0, 0x7e29e0).

Writes the continent adjective: the record's own (+0x23) or, in languages 9, 5 and 4, the text by continent and adjective form. \n The community map gives 629 bytes; the routine runs to 0x6181c5: 2518. `get_continent_adjective(continent, text, size, form)`: clears the text and copies the continent's adjective. Form (byte) 0 or language (0x66f4d0) other than 9, 5 and 4: the record's own adjective (+0x23). Otherwise the language's text by continent (id +0 compared with the keys `[0x9cfa08..0x9cfa18]`, in that order) and by the adjective form (0x545a60, already in Rust, through the game's address). Returns 1. Null continent or text, or size (signed short) < 50: the original (0). Used in the search (find_screens), the Menubar, the day's matches (0x717cc0, in Rust) and 0x7dd400.

Matches the database club name with the 313 fixed club keys (372 names in 4 chains, _stricmp): the first hit of each chain stores the row in the key's global. \n Matches the database's club name with the game's fixed keys (CLUB_KEYS): in each chain, the first text equal to the name (_stricmp 0x951c50, case-insensitive) stores the `row` in the key's global and the chain ends; with no hit, it moves on to the next. Returns the original's eax: the result of the last _stricmp (0 if the last chain hit).

After the club table trim, the first club key holding the old id gets the new one (returns 1; none: 0). \n After the club table is trimmed to the database size (0x5267c0), the first club key (in CLUB_KEYS_SWAP_ORDER order) that holds the id `old` is set to `new` and the routine returns 1; none: 0.

Matches the database nation name with the 209 fixed nation keys (217 names in 2 chains, _stricmp). \n Matches the database's nation name with the game's fixed keys (NATION_KEYS): in each chain, the first text equal to the name (_stricmp 0x951c50, case-insensitive) stores the `row` in the key's global and the chain ends; with no hit, it moves on to the next. Returns the original's eax: the result of the last _stricmp (0 if the last chain hit).

Matches the club competition long name with the 301 fixed keys (351 names in 3 chains, _stricmp; the two Croatian divisions also store 0x9cf8a4). \n Matches the database's club competition name with the game's fixed keys (CLUB_COMPETITION_KEYS): in each chain, the first text equal to the name (_stricmp 0x951c50, case-insensitive) stores the `row` in the key's global and the chain ends; with no hit, it moves on to the next. Returns the original's eax: the result of the last _stricmp (0 if the last chain hit).

Matches the staff competition or award name with the 417 fixed keys (442 names in 5 chains, _stricmp). \n Matches the database's person competition or award name with the game's fixed keys (PERSON_COMPETITION_KEYS): in each chain, the first text equal to the name (_stricmp 0x951c50, case-insensitive) stores the `row` in the key's global and the chain ends; with no hit, it moves on to the next. Returns the original's eax: the result of the last _stricmp (0 if the last chain hit).

Adjusts the board's confidence after the match: the rivalry, the reputation gap or the team and opponent ratings in the match, the score, the aggregate, the derby and rival, the competition weight; writes the four confidence values (1 to 10000, with floors by stage), raises the media stories and the fan protest, and decides whether to consider sacking the manager. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::update_board_confidence_after_match(club, fixture, match, home)`, called from the board after the match (0x6951e0, one side at a time). The adjustment starts from the rivalry (±20/30 against the opponent or by the fixture's national side +0x18), adds the reputation difference / 35 (without a match) or, with the match, the team rating (average of the ratings by age +0x1c4, the ratings +0x127/+0x128, the difference with the opponent, the sum of +0x4d − rating; x87: (... + 0.1) × 67 − 470, × factor) plus the average reputation of the opponents (by nation, 0x53d980) against the club's / 40, up to ±100. By the score (+0x47/+0x48 or +0x43/+0x44): win 0x800, defeat 0x1000 (outside friendlies, × 2 or × 5 with a thrashing; below −50 with an AI manager, the request to the FA 0x6a9e60 by random draw), draw 0x400 (in the cup, +15 and the stages 0x7b/0x7c/0x85/0x86/0x99/0x9a). The aggregate (+0x4b/+0x4c, +0x49/+0x4a, +0x43/+0x44) gives 0x100/0x200 and ±10/15/20; the derby (0x40, same city or a rival within 25 km) or the rival/clash (0x80) multiply the weight (2.25 or 1.5) and give ±12/±5. Weight × 0.5 for the B national team, × 2 for the senior one, × 2 or 1.5 in the cup (flag 0x400 of the row); the adjustment × weight, ÷ 3 or ÷ 2 by the flags. The flags 1/2/4/8/0x10/0x20 (by the score, the adjustment and confidence +6) go into the text (0x6a69c0) and into the reaction news (0x6a5fa0, human manager only). The media story 0x3d (0x74b060, −250 at +0x16) by random draw at a manageable club; story 0x5c in the league with the club in danger. The confidence: +6 += 0.7 ×, +0xa += 0.5 ×, +8 += 1.15 ×, +0xc += 0.2 × (half with flag 0x7a7eb0 when negative), between 1 and 10000; floors by stage and by the competition's strength; the fan protest (0x6a5d10); in the league or when negative, consider sacking (0x69aba0, 1 on a defeat); otherwise it leaves the ultimatum list (0x68d1f0).

Posts news item 0x138c with the board's reaction to the match for the club's manager: the flags, the clubs, the scores, the named players and the match record. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_board_match_reaction_news(club, opponent, fixture, flags, a, b, c, d)`: with club, opponent, fixture and competition (+0x14), news 0x138c (0x77bbe0) with the flags, the two ids, the scores a and b, the aggregate c and d and the fixture's +8; the up to 3 players the board names (0x6aaee0, with defeat = a > b), a random(4), the defeat and their 5 flags; the club's match record (0x7e4750) written into the news (0x7e4de0); delivered to the club's manager (0x7861e0).

Posts news item 0x1781 with the FA's assessment of the national team manager in a competition, from the game start. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_fa_performance_news(competition, national_team, rating)`: from the game start date (`[0xdd6ec8]`) on, news 0x1781 (0x77bbe0) with the national team's id, the competition's id (*competition) and the FA's rating, through the reach (0x786090 with the national team and 0, 0, 0, 0).

Sets the board's season expectations: the target in the league (danger position, wealth, previous division, manager tenure) and the expectation flags (title, European places, top half, avoid relegation), the chairman draws, the departure by tenure, the confidence values pulled back to 6500 and the manager record; a national team takes those of its competition. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::set_season_expectations(club, news)`. Clears the flags (+0xe) and the target (+0x2c), +0x30 = reputation² / 4, +0x38 ÷ 4, +0 = 0. Without flag 1 of +2, with a manager and outside national teams: by the manager's days in the job (0x54cdb0), above 3650 with confidence +6 < 3500 (random(30) above the chairman's +0x1d, or 10) or above 1825 with +6 < 3000 (random(20)), the item {1, 6, id} in list `[this+4]` (0x68d0d0). National team: the B team nothing; the senior one takes its competition's expectations (0x7751e0 and virtual +0x70) and the FA news (0x6a44a0). Club: the nation's UEFA places (0x905c60 on `[0xde1f58]`); without a manager nothing; without a division with a competition: 0x10. The target = the danger position of the league row (+0x72; without it, 8 with 0x40 and the news, and it returns), minus 1 if it is the last one; by wealth (0x5986b0: 2 → −3/−2, 1 → −2/−1, 0 with budget (0x598800) above 250 × reputation → −1, −1 → +1 below 5, −2 → +1); by the previous division (+0x5b: stronger +4/+2, weaker −7/−3/−2) or by the manager's days (below 365 +1; above 1095 −1 above 10); between 1 and the number of clubs − 1; with flag 1, the average with the row's +0x73 between +0x74 and +0x75. The flags: 2 (champion's place), 1 (UEFA places, outside Australia), 4 (+0xbe), 8 (+0xbf), 0x40 (top half), 0x20 (avoid relegation, +0xc1) or 0x10/0; chairman draws (0x80, 0x100, 0x200 by the target) and the cup league (`[0xae23d0]`, 0x400 or the swap 0x80/0x200). The news (0x6a4a20). Confidence values below 6500 rise to (5x + 27500 or 25000) / 10; the wealth into +1; the manager's record (+0xa, +0xc) rises to the club's reputation; the new manager (of the last 16) gets 1 in +0x59 up to 20; clears +2, +3, +4, +5, +0x12..+0x16, +0x28 and +0x40 & 7; the fines (0x5a5930 on `[0xae2a3c]`).

Resets the club board and picks the manager for the vacancy: the best score among the free people who qualify (or the assistant, or the first free one counting backwards), sometimes a better drawn one; the announcement and arrival dates and the item in the vacancy list; the human managers apply. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::add_job_vacancy(club, departing_manager)`. Club without a division and with reputation below 5000: nothing; B national team with ranking (nation's +0x88) up to 1000 or senior team up to 100: nothing. The board starts over (the four confidence values 5000, +0xe = 0x10, the flags cleared). The chosen one: from all people with a manager record (+0x69; the last 16, the humans, only with +0x5f), except the one who left, without state 0x30, without a contract (0x4cf6d0), off the lists (0x69fc60), of the same nation or with +0xa ≥ 3750, of the same continent (+0x75) or with +0xc ≥ 4250 and the club with reputation ≥ 4750, suited to the job (0x69f810 with 3.5), excluding players with a contract in force in jobs 11/12/13/15, only national team managers (+0x3d = 5) for a national team: the highest score (0x69d1b0). With nobody: the assistant (+0xd3), the first of +0x19f or, from back to front starting at the 17th from last, the first free person in jobs 0, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15 (without wrapping around: the "Can't find a manager" box and nothing). National team or big club (reputation above 4500 + random(2000)): draws as many people as their count and keeps the best free one (with 150 days in the job, 3.15). The human rejected by the club (0x547e70). The dates: before the game start, 1 to 7 days after it (the announcement) and the arrival 1 to 7 days later; otherwise, the announcement in 1 to 3 days and the arrival in 4 to 8 days (7 to 11 if the one who left is human; 10 to 14 with the offer news 0x6a0540 to the chosen one's human club), sometimes 0 to 19 more; the turn of the year. The item goes into list `[this+8]` (0x68d0d0, the cursor saved); the humans (0x5fd210, 0x5fea50) of smaller clubs apply (0x69ca00).

Posts news item 0x1775 telling the club's manager that another club offered one of his staff the manager job. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_job_offer_news(person, club)`: with the person employed (+0x39) and the club, from the game start (`[0xdd6ec8]`) on, news 0x1775 (0x77bbe0) with the person's id, the three names (+0x33 of +4, +8, +0xc), the id of the club where they are, that of the offering club and the job (+0x3d), to the manager of their club (0x7861e0).

After the match, by a random draw, gathers the league position for the news and the manager's favoured or rejected players who played badly, with the board confidence rising or falling because of them. \n Called from the board's news after the match (0x6a5fa0): `(match, club, ids, fixture, praise, a6..a10)`. Sets the 3 ids to −1. Club outside the national teams with a manager (+0xbf) with a record (+0x69): random(the record's +0x16) against random(10); if it passes, it clears the 5 outputs and, in a match of the club's division, a10 = 1 and, from the league table (0x4a4850, with more than 8 matches), a9/a8 (the row's +0x74/+0x73), a7 (the board's +0x2c) and a6 (2 or 0xfe by the row's +0x19/+0x2d). The players (job 11, with a record) that the manager rejects (0x5480f0, if `praise` = 0) or favours (0x548090), of the club by contract (0x4cf5a0, on `[0xae1080]`), below the club's reputation (rejected) or up to 35 years old and above it − 750 (favoured), with a rating below 7 in the match (0x6ab670 = −1): their ids go into `ids` and the board confidence (+6) rises (favoured) or falls (rejected) by 10 × the manager's +0x57. Returns the sum of the two counts (the caller does not read it).

Finds the player among the starters of the match record: −1 for a rating under 7, 1 above, otherwise 0. \n SEH frame for the local array. `get_player_match_rating_verdict(person, fixture)`: reads the match record (0x729600 on `[0xb6b7c0]`, with the two 0x625-byte sides constructed and destroyed by the iterators 0x9463af/0x9462bb) and looks for the person among the first 11 of each side (ids at +0x71, 0x49 bytes): a rating (+0x35) below 7 gives −1, above 7 gives 1, 7 gives 0; not found (or no person), 0. The ecx is irrelevant.

Builds the board sentence praising or blaming the named player, by variant. \n `build_board_player_performance_text(ids, win, output, variant)`, called from the board text (0x6a69c0). The original keeps only the first id that is not −1 (in its own place, 0, 1 or 2), counts 1, and the texts always read place 0. Win: with the first one, the name (0x53dba0, 200, style 1) in one of the three praises by variant (0, 1, other); then, since no player counts on a defeat, the output stays empty (the original clears the first byte). Defeat: the output empty and, with the first one, one of the four blames by variant (0, 1, 2, other), with 100 and the name. Without ids, nothing.

Checks whether the board vetoes a transfer: when buying an injured player, the physios draw the veto; at a human club, the board vetoes on budget, asking price or fee and loses confidence. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::check_board_transfer_veto(player, club, amount, buying)`, called from 0x8cdb80 (offer without a swap). When buying a player with an injury (0x62ed70) of severity +0x28 > 20, each of the club's three physios (+0x1cf, with a record +0x69) seeds the CRT rand with the two ids and draws: retirement announced because of the injury (0x7a7ed0) against his rating (0x544410 of byte +0x1e), the severity against random(200) + 25 and (41 − rating) × 5, the relapse (0x62ece0), rating³ + 100 (pow 0x945ff0) and the rating against the player's (+0x61 +0x2d): any of them vetoes (0x2000); at the end the rand goes back to the clock (0x946ebb). Then, only with a contract outside types 1 and 3, a current club (+0x39) and a human club (0x600a50): the limit (reputation +0x80 × 0.2)² between 150 thousand and 2 million. Selling: a league with a division and a squad below 15, the board loses 1250/1250/500 (+6/+0x14/+0x16, floor 1 on +6) and vetoes 0x200; otherwise the asking price (0x4d1600, at most the value for the contract's club) above the limit and the value for the current club not below `amount`: asking > 2 × amount with the contract's +0x3d > 25, or asking > 5 million with +0x3d > 0 and > 2.5 × amount, lose 1250/1250/500; > 6 × amount, 500/500/250; veto 0x800. Buying: an amount above 1.2 × the budget (0x598800) vetoes 0x800; above the limit, the lowest value (for the club and for the contract's club) + 0.65 × limit + the wealth band (0x5986b0: 1.25 million, 650 thousand or 65 thousand), truncated, below 0.275 × amount loses 250/500/500 and vetoes 0x800. Otherwise 0.

Posts the 0x178d news of the ultimatum before the match, to the club's manager or, by a random draw, to those of the division or the country. \n SEH frame for the local news item. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_board_ultimatum_news(club, opponent, competition)`, called from the board ultimatum (0x6ac560). Club with a division (+0x57), a manager (+0xcf) and the competition: news 0x178d with the manager (the id and the three keys), the club, the opponent, the competition and a random(5); a club with reputation (+0x80) below 5750, to the club's manager (0x7861e0); otherwise, by random(3), to the division's managers (0x7862d0) or to the country's (+0x53, 0x7863f0).

Writes the headline or body of the ultimatum news, with the names and links of the manager and the clubs. \n `news_board_ultimatum_text(news, body, output)`: reads fields 0 to 7 of the news (0x785830: the manager, the three keys, the club, the opponent, the competition); the manager's name (0x53dba0, 500, style 1). Body: text 0xa12dac in 0xde1f64 (0x66f4e0) with the genders (the clubs' +0x37, the competition's +0x52), the names (the clubs' +4, the competition's +0x38) and the manager's, into `output` (0x4ae660), and the links (0x4ae8a0): the manager (0x7da, if the names match via 0x53e990), the club and the opponent (0x7d5). Headline: 0xa12d64 with the club's gender (+0x52) and short name (+0x38).

Posts the 0x1777 news with the manager, the club and the chairman; the reason by the board ratings below confidence − 500 (random draws of 3 and 5) and the rumour (random draw of 10, or 1 when the manager knows the club well); delivered to all, to the nation or to the division's managers; today's date into +0x18 of the board row. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_manager_under_pressure_news(club, kind)`, called when considering sacking the manager (0x69aba0: kind 1 when swapping for the best candidate, 2 after 14 days). Club without a manager (+0xcf) or before the date `[0xdd6ec8]`: nothing. News 0x1777: the manager (0..3), the club (4), the chairman (+0xbf: 5..7 and the id in 10; without one, −1). The reason (8) from the board row (+6 the confidence): rating +8, +0xa or +0xc below confidence − 500 with random(3) zero gives 2, 1 or 3 (+1 with random(5) non-zero); otherwise 0. The kind (9) and the rumour (11): random(10), or 1 if the manager knows the club well (0x544410 of the non-player +0x69 with +0x1b above 10). Delivery: human manager, to all; club with reputation above 5000, to the country's; otherwise to those of the division (+0x57) unless it is `[0x9cf764]`. Finally today's date into the row's +0x18 (0x417c10).

Posts the 6000 news with the manager, the kind, the club, the job, the chairman and the reason; a human manager with the names and to all; otherwise by the club (national team or reputation above 7250 to all, otherwise to the nation). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_manager_departure_news(manager, kind, reason, club, job)`, called when removing the manager from the job (0x69b790). Null manager or club, before the date `[0xdd6ec8]` or kind 5: nothing. News 6000: the manager (0..3), the kind (4), the club (5), the job (7), the chairman's keys (+0xbf: 8..10; without one, −1) and the reason (11). Human manager: his names from data slot 13 on (the next free one in 12) and to all; otherwise by the club (0x544820; national team or reputation above 7250 to all, otherwise to the country's).

Posts the 0x1787 news of a manager appointment, only for a club of an active nation with an active division, or a national team of an active nation: the manager, the previous club, the club, the job and the previous role; delivered like the departure news. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_manager_appointment_news(manager, previous, club, job)`, called from the manager market's day (0x68f9c0) and from the appointment (0x69ebc0). Null manager or club, before the date `[0xdd6ec8]` or job 5: nothing. Only a club of an active nation (the nation's +0x11c) with its division in the array `[0xadadfc]`, or a national team (0x53b900) of an active nation. News 0x1787: the manager (0..3), the previous club (4; −1), the club (5), the job (6) and the previous role (7: +0x28 for a national team, +0x3d for a club; without a previous one, −1). Human manager: the names from data slot 8 on (the next free one in 7) and to all; otherwise by the club, like the departure news.

Returns the board's league confidence (+0x12 of the club's 0x49-byte record) in bands 0 to 6 (−2000, −1000, −500, 500, 1000, 2000). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::get_league_confidence_band(club)`: the board's confidence in the league (signed word +0x12 of the club's 0x49-byte record in `[this]`) in bands: below −2000: 0; −1000: 1; −500: 2; 500: 3; 1000: 4; 2000: 5; otherwise 6. Used by the confidence text (0x690d80). Only `al` counts (the rest of eax is what was left from the address computation).

Sets the four board ratings (+6, +8, +0xc, +0xa of the club's 0x49-byte record) to the value. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::set_board_ratings(club, value)`: the four board ratings (+6, +8, +0xc and +0xa of the club's 0x49-byte record in `[this]`, words, in that order) receive the value (16 bits). Called from the players' initial setup (0x7a46a6).

Posts the 0x1772 board confidence news with the manager's days in the job. \n SEH frame with no destructor. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_board_confidence_update_news(club)`: before the news date, nothing. News 0x1772 (local): 0 = the club's id, 1 = the manager's (+0xcf) days in the job (since date +0x3e, 365 days per year) or 100 without a manager; through the reach (0x786090) with the club.

Posts the 0x1771 board expectations news to the club's manager. \n SEH frame with no destructor. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_board_expectations_news(club, expectations)`: before the news date, nothing. News 0x1771 (local): 0 = the club's id, 1 = the expectations (signed word); to the club's manager (0x7861e0).

Posts the 0x177e news of the FA's expectation for the national team in a competition. \n SEH frame with no destructor. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_fa_expectations_news(national_team, expectation, competition)`: news 0x177e (local): 0 = the national team's id, 1 = the expectation (signed word), 2 = the competition; through the reach (0x786090) with the national team.

Posts the 0x1782 news of the supporters protesting against the manager. \n SEH frame with no destructor. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_supporter_protest_news(club)`: before the news date (`[0xdd6ec8]`), nothing. News 0x1782 (local): 0 = the club's id, 1..4 the manager (+0xcf: the id and the three keys +0x33 of +4, +8, +0xc); through the reach (0x786090).

Fixes the jobs of staff with a club (manager at +0xcf) and builds each club's board row: dates, reputation squared, the four confidence values drawn from the expectation (board rating or reputation) and the reputation, held to 5750/5500..10000, or 5000 without a manager; the season expectations (0x6a3770) and, without a manager, the vacancy (0x69ba50). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::init_club_board_records()`: at the start of the career (from the constructor 0x68dbf0). (1) Each person with a club (+0x24): function (+0x28) 5 or 12 becomes the club's manager (+0xcf); 11 stays; 13 and 15 become 11 (with a player record +0x61) or 8; the others lose the club; without a contract (+0x39) and without an original function (+0x3d), the function goes to +0x3d; outside 11 the function is cleared. (2) Each club (national teams only with a nation and +0x71): the second national team has its reputation (+0x80) capped at 200 × the nation's (+0x8e) and the slots cleared; its row (73 bytes in `[this]`) gets the dates (23/07/1971 at +0x41, today at +0x18), reputation² × 0.25 (double at +0x30) and zeros. With a manager: the date 23/08/1971 at +0x20 (by the id's row), the expectation `f` (the reputation, the board rating +0xa or 4500, which drops to 0.75 × reputation), `h` = f / (reputation × 0.5 + 2500) × 7500 and the four confidence values (+6, +8, +0xa, +0xc) by random draws, clamped below (5750, or 5500 with a draw) and above (10000; +6 above 9500 becomes 10000 − random(500)); clears the flags and sets the season expectations (0x6a3770 with 1). Without a manager (outside the partner club): confidence 5000, +0xe = 16, flags cleared; a manageable club (or one with a competition and a nation with +0x11c & 3) gets the expectations and the vacancy (0x69ba50).

Processes the ban appeals: for each appeal (+0x14) whose date has come, the result is applied on up to 4 discipline rule sets (0x557000), the news is sent (0x6ac060) and the appeal leaves the list. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::process_ban_appeals()`: walks the appeals list (+0x14, the count a signed word re-read on each iteration) and, for each one whose date (+5) is no longer after today (0x456740), with a result (+4): the up to 4 rules (+0xd..+0x10, ≥ 0) receive the result in the discipline (0x557000 with fields +0x11..+0x18); then the result news (0x6ac060) and the appeal leaves (0x68d1f0). Null item: the "Error" box (0x57f5) and it stops. Called from the board's daily pass (0x68f9c0); only the human's appeals enter the list.

Considers sacking the manager: with low board confidence and the manager in the job for 150 days, the limit comes from the division table, the runs and the manager flag; chairman draws hold back, issue the ultimatum, let the manager leave or sack him (the departure queued, reason 0x69b350), or look for a better candidate with the pressure story. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::consider_sacking_manager(club, check)`: before the date `[0xdd6ec8]` (0x456770), with bit 2 in +2 of the board row, with the ultimatum resolved (0x6ac470, only with `check`), with confidence (+6) above 4275 or with the manager in the job for less than 150 days: nothing. A well-regarded manager (the non-player's +0xa above 5000 and above the club's reputation +0x80 − 750) for less than 400 days: with random(chairman's patience +0x1d, or 10) ≠ 0 the confidence goes to 4275. The limit (10 above 3500, 500 up to 3000, 200 in between) changes by the club's row in the division table (0x4a4850): position (+4) above 30 − patience/2 in the top places (+0xbf, or +0xbe by the competition's virtual +0x98) holds; the last 5 results (+0x14..+0x18) averaging above 2 hold; the runs +0x19, +0x41, +0x55 and +0x2d move the limit (×1.5 on +0x55). With the manager flagged (0x7a7eb0), the limit ×0.25. random(patience × 50, or 500) above the limit holds; random(patience + 1, or 11) = 0 gives the ultimatum (0x6ac560; once given, nothing more). An AI manager (0x600a50), without the flag, with random(+0x5a) and random(4) zero leaves (departure 2). With a chairman: at a league club or national team, random(patience) < 5 and random(20) ≠ 0 tries to swap for the best candidate; otherwise the pressure news (0x6a0e70 with 2) after 14 days, and that is all. Without a chairman: random(3) = 0 tries the swap. Without a swap, the non-player's confidence drops by 250 (minimum 1500 with a chairman, 1 without) and the manager is sacked (departure 1).

Issues the board ultimatum for the club's first match in the next 8 weeks (not today, still to play): the ultimatum story with the opponent and the club in the ultimatum list; returns 1, or 0 without a match. \n SEH frame for the local list. `MANAGER_MANAGER::issue_board_ultimatum(club)`: club with a manager (+0xcf) and a division (+0x57): the local list (LLIST 0x68d020, released by 0x68d040) receives the matches of the next 8 weeks; the first valid one gives the ultimatum news and puts the club in the ultimatum list `[this+0x10]`: returns 1. Otherwise 0.

Removes the manager from the club: the departure date, the squad and the staff, the contract (outside national teams), the story (outside type 3), confidence at 3500 (unless kept), the job change record, the fines and the squad contracts' grievances and flags. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::remove_club_manager(club, kind, reason, keep)`: with the manager in the job: at the human club (0x600a50) the automatic replies (0x7874b0); the departure date (+0x29 for a national team, +0x3e for a club) becomes today's; with a manager job (12, 13 or 15) he leaves the squad (0x690730); he leaves the staff (0x690890); outside national teams he loses the contract (0x4d0b50); outside type 3 the departure news (0x6a1b00 with 2 for manager jobs, 3 for the others); without `keep` the confidence (+6 of the row) goes to 3500. The change record (0x869aa0, with 0 for kind 2 and 2 for the others), the club's fines (0x5a5960) and, outside national teams, the grievances and flags of each squad player with a contract (0x4cf5a0) are removed.

Reviews the national team's performance: the FA confidence from the manager's grade in the competition (−3..3, virtual +0x74), the assessment story and, by time in the job, reputation and random draws, the manager's departure or the FA considering the sacking (0x69aba0). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::review_national_team_performance(comp, national_team)`: a national team with a manager (+0xcf) and a competition in `[0xadadfc]`: with the manager there for less than 365 days, the FA confidence (+6 of the row) rises to 6500. The manager's grade in the competition (its virtual +0x74) changes the confidence: 3: +1250 (ceiling 10000, floor 8500); 2: +750 (ceiling 10000, floor 6500), and the AI national team with the manager there for more than 3650 days lets him go if random(15000) + 3750 < reputation (+0x80); 0: −250 and, only with the row's +0xe = −3, 3500 and the departure (more than 3650 days) or, with reputation above 6750 and more than 1460 days, random(15000) against the reputation (below: departure; otherwise the FA considers it, 0x69aba0); −1: −750 (1..3500), departure after 1460 days, random(20000) after 730; −2: −1250 (1..3000), departure after 730 days, otherwise random(15000) + 1250; −3: −1750 (1..3000) and the departure. The assessment goes into the news (0x6a5a60) right after the change. The departures carry reason 6 (2, 0 and −1 with longer tenure) or 0.

Returns 1 for a manageable club, not a national team, with board confidence at row +8 under 3000 and a negative balance. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::is_club_in_financial_trouble(club)`: a manageable club (0x544820), not a national team (0x53b900), with the board confidence at +8 of the row below 3000 and the balance (64 bits in the finance record, 0x5a0590 on `[0xae2a38]`) negative: 1. Otherwise 0. Used by the match engine (crowd chants).

Returns the 0..6 band of the board confidence (limits 3000, 3500, 4275, 6500, 8500, 9500). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::get_board_confidence_band(club)`: the band (0..6) of the board confidence (+6 of the row) by the limits 3000, 3500, 4275, 6500, 8500 and 9500. Used by the board report text (0x690d80).

Resets the board for a new manager: recalculates the expectations, moves the manager's reputation towards the club's and draws the board confidence and moods from the reputation; clears the changes and flags, records the manager and stores the wealth band. \n In DESLIGADAS since 2026-10-30: with the detour, the career in Rust mode left the reference be54a138 (bisection of the 39 routines of batch 252); the cause (stack residue or a difference in the copy) is not isolated yet; the copy stays in the code and does not run. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::reset_board_for_new_manager(club)`: sets bit 1 of +2 of the board row, recalculates the season expectations (0x6a3770 with the news) and sets it again; the club list of the Shortlist_Manager (+0xdc, 9 bytes per club, +4) is set to 2. The manager's (+0xcf, record +0x69) reputation: in the same nation (+0x53 = the manager's +0x1a) the current (+0xa) and domestic (+8) move 10% towards the club's (+0x80); otherwise the current moves 10% starting from the other-nation one (+0xc). The base: the current reputation (zero: half the club's, or 5000 without; below 500: 500 + a random draw of 1000) over the club's (zero: itself; below 500: 250 + a random draw of 750) × 7500, as a float; above the double at 0x96d1b0 (read as a double: a positive denormal) it becomes 10000, below 6500, 6500. The confidence (+6) and the moods +8/+0xa/+0xc come from the base with two random draws of 500 each (limits 6250..9500, 6250..10000, 5250..10000, 5750..10000, with random draws on the lower ones); clears the changes +0x10..+0x16, the doubles +0x38, +0x28, +4, +5 and flags (+2 &~0x2e, +3 &0xe0, +0x40 &7). Records the new manager (0x869aa0 with 1). With a human manager (id ≥ `[0xae2364]` − 16): cancels the club's offers (0x8c4950), rebuilds the club's list (0x84abe0) and the tactics of the 50 slots (0x896c60). +1 = the finances' wealth band (0x5986b0), 0 for national teams or without finances.

Returns the reason (0 to 11) for the manager's departure: unsettled players, league position, debt, board changes and moods (with random draws) and time in the job. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::get_departure_reason(id)`: the reason (0..11) for the departure of the manager of club `id`. National team (0x53b900): 0. More than 2 squad players with grievance 0x10000000 in the contract (+0x45): 9. In the season (0x547770): in the league with the nation flagged (+0x11c), a table row with more than 25 (+4) and more than 1 match (+0x55), by the competition's position 0x9c: progress (+0x73) inside and the projected position (0x4ae300) outside the (+0x3e − +0xc1) places: 11; debt (double +0x30 < +0x38) with the change +0x12 below −300: 10. Then: +0x12 below −750 outside a type 1 run (0x690c30) with a random draw of 3 = 0: 2; in the season with bit 8 of +2: 7; +0x10 < −350: 3; +0x14 < −750: 5; mood +0xa below confidence +6 and random(+0xa) < random(+6): 8; +0x16 < −750 with a random draw of 3 ≠ 0: 4; the manager in the job for more days (0x54cdb0 since +0x3e) than 1000 + a random draw of 2000: 6. Otherwise 0.

Flags the deal for buyer and seller by the fee/player value ratio (bands for values above or up to 250,000; a fee up to (reputation × 0.2)² is fair), adds and subtracts the value from each one's net spend and flags the club's and chairman's favoured or disliked player. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::assess_transfer_deal(transfer, f1, f2)`: with the player (+0xc) who has a record (+0x61), clears the two flag words and: for the buying club (+8, 0x245-byte record) adds the player's value (0x4d0c60, 1 if 0) to the net spend (+0x38) and flags `f1` by the ratio fee (0x8e7a70) / value: fee up to the limit (reputation × 0.2)² = 4; value above 250,000: < 0.2 = 0x10, < 0.5 = 8, < 2 = 4, < 6 = 2, otherwise 1; up to 250,000: < 0.125 = 8, < 8 = 4, otherwise 2; the favoured or rejected player of the club or of the chairman (+0xbf; 0x547790/0x5477d0/0x547810/0x547840) = 0x40 or 0x100. For the selling club (the player's +0x39) it subtracts the value from the spend and flags `f2` with the mirrored bands (0.25/0.5/2/4; 0.125/8) and 0x20 or 0x80. Transfer already assessed (+0x1f = 1): nothing (the flags stay as they are).

Changes the board confidence (+6, 1..10000) and moods (+0x14, +0x16) of the buyer and the seller from the deal flags and removes the player from the seller chairman's favoured people. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::apply_transfer_confidence_changes(transfer)`: assesses the deal (0x696570) with the buyer's flags in the slot of the argument itself and the seller's in the slot of the pushed `ecx` (already assessed, +0x1f = 1: the pointer's bits stay, as in the original) and changes the board row of the buyer (+8) and, if the seller (the player's +0x39) is not a national team (0x53b900) and does not have finances with +0x165 = 1 (0x5a0590), the seller's: ratio 1: −125/−500, 2: −25/−250, 8: +25/+25, 0x10: +75/+75 (confidence +6 and mood +0x14); favoured and rejected on mood +0x16 (and +0x14). Clamps the confidence to 1..10000 and +0x16 to −10000 or more; at the end the player is removed from the seller chairman's favoured people (0x547c10).

Removes the club from the ultimatum list and, when the manager has been in the job over 100 days, queues his departure (reason 2, or 7 without games in the table) and returns 1. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::resolve_board_ultimatum(club)`: walks the ultimatum list (+0x10, up to the count, which drops with each removal) and removes the club's item (0x68d1f0); if the manager (+0xcf) has been in the job for more than 100 days (0x54cdb0 since +0x3e), it puts the departure in the list (+4, 0x68d0d0, 6 bytes: 1, reason 2, or 7 if the club's row in the division table (0x4a4850) has no matches (+0x55), and the club's id), sets bit 2 in +2 of the board row and returns 1. Otherwise 0.

Walks the pending departure list and, at each club with a manager, carries out his departure and, when the club opens a vacancy, the vacancy; removes each item from the list. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::process_pending_departures()`: walks the pending departures list (+4, 6-byte items: two bytes and the club's id at +2) up to the count (which drops with each removal: the original goes through only part of the items) and, for each item, with a manager at the club (+0xcf) calls the departure (0x69b790 with the two bytes pushed in the integer registers: the upper bits are those of the id and of 145 × id) and, if the club opens a vacancy (0x544820), the vacancy (0x69ba50 with the departing manager); removes the item (0x68d1f0). Null item: the "Error" box.

Takes the player out of the club (or the national team): a player-manager job goes back to the staff job (otherwise 0xb and he leaves), out of the lists, the media, the tactics and the 50 squad slots; the loan gets state 4. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::remove_player_from_squad(person, club)`: at the person's club (+0x39): the player-manager function (+0x3d) goes back to the manager one (12 → 5, 13 → 6, 15 → 8) or becomes 0xb and the person leaves the club; removed from the lists (0x7c5fe0), the media (0x843e10 with 4, 2), the club's two tactics (0x896c60) and the 50 squad slots (+0xd7). For the national team (+0x24, function +0x28) the same without 0x7c5fe0 and 0x843e10. At the end the loan contract (0x4cf5a0) gets state +0x4e = 4. Returns the result of 0x4cf5a0.

Gives each club without a manager (0x53ca90), manageable (0x544820), not a B team and without an entry in the `[this+8]` list the "Job not found" note and a job vacancy (0x69ba50). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::fix_missing_jobs()`: each club (`[0xae23b4]`, 0x245 bytes, `[0xae235c]` re-read on each iteration) without a manager, manageable, not a B team and without an open vacancy (`club_needs_vacancy`) gets the note "Job not found for %s" (name +4) in `[0xde1f64]` and the vacancy (0x69ba50 without a previous manager). A list that ends before the count: the "Error" box (line 0x311e) and the routine ends. No SEH, no random draw; the partner local starts at 0 only once and is read only when 0x540a50 finds it (and writes it).

Returns the highest manager score (0x69d1b0, job 5) among the available staff accepted for the club (nation, continent, reputation, contract, 0x69f810), ignoring the current manager; nobody: −10000. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::best_manager_candidate_score(club, current)`: the highest manager score (0x69d1b0 with 0 and job 5) among the people (`[0xae23bc]`, 0x6e bytes, `[0xae2364]` re-read on each iteration) with a staff record (+0x69), of the last 16 only the human ones (+0x5f), who are not `current`, without flags 0x30 in byte +0xb of the 79-byte record (`[0xae2d0c]`), without a loan contract (0x4cf6d0), who are not candidates for another vacancy (0x69fc60), with a nation (+0x1a) and the club with a nation (+0x53): from another nation only with reputation (+0x69 → +0xa) from 3750; from another continent (+0x75) with +0x69 → +0xc from 4250 and the club with reputation (+0x80) from 4750; a player (+0x61) with a club (+0x39) and job 11, 12, 13 or 15 cannot have a contract with the club (0x4cf5f0) flagged in +0x49; and accepted for the job (0x69f810 with 3.5). Nobody: −10000.

For a played match, changes the board confidence of each side with a manager (0x695240, home with 1). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::update_board_after_fixture(fixture, match)`: a played fixture (+0 ≠ −2, +0x40 ≠ 0): the board confidence of each side with a manager (+0xcf) changes through 0x695240 (home +0x1c with 1, away +0x20 with 0).

Is the person in the list (iterator 0x68d1b0, restored at the end)? \n Is the person `*p` in the list `[this+8]` (count word at +0, iterator 0x68d1b0 with the position at +0xa, restarted from +2 and restored at the end)? A list that ends before the count: the original (error box). Returns only `al`.

Decides whether the person is a realistic candidate for the club's manager job: vetoes and accepts by reputation, nation, contract and time in the job; otherwise their interest in the job against the minimum score (double). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::is_staff_suitable_for_job(person, club, min_score)`: without a non-player record (+0x69) or without a club: 0. The vetoes (0): other-nation reputation (+0xc) above 4250 from another nation with weight (+0x85) below 10; domestic (+8) above 6250, a manager (+0x3d = 5) from another nation and a club below 5750; a national team that is already one of their three (+0x65 +0x10..+0x18); a player (0xb) with a rating (+0x61 +0xb) above 4750 at a club below 6750, with a contract (0x4cf5a0) of band 1..3 (+0x4f >> 4), less than 180 days, +0x3f above 1, +0x3e zero, younger than 35 with +0x3d positive, or from another nation at a club below 7250 that is not their own; a club manager in a better division (+0x57 +0x69), or a stronger one, or recently appointed (days since +0x3e below (+0x59 + 21) × 10) at a club above 5250; a national team manager (+0x24, +0x28 = 5); a club below 2250 (with reputation +0xa above 4750 or without a record); +0x22 above 75 at a club below 3250; a non-player with retirement pending (0x7ae350). The yeses (1): a club below 2500 of their nation, domestic below 1500, without a club or national team; their nation's national team with reputation below 6750, without a club, or with their club weaker (below 7750 and 750 below the national team) for a while; a club above 7750 with the perceived reputation above their club's + 25 × +0x59 + 250. Otherwise, their interest in the job (0x844780, float) not below `min_score`.

Removes from the list the first node whose item has the same bytes as the data (head, tail, count and cursor fixed) and frees it with its item; 1 when removed. \n `LLIST::remove(data)`: the first node with the bytes of `data` (find_list_node_by_bytes) leaves the list: the head (+2) or the previous node's next, the tail (+6) or the next node's previous, the count (+0, word) − 1, the cursor (+0xa) moves on if it was on it; the item (0x68d010) and the node (0x944c94) are freed. Returns 1; not found, 0. Used by ~77 callers (lists of offers, absences, ultimatums, manager vacancies, friendlies...).

Returns the first run (types 1, 3, 4, 2) of more than 1 match with the last one under 10 days ago, from the club's row in the league statistics; otherwise 5 and 0. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::get_current_run(club, kind, length)`: the club's current run in the league (+0x57; the competition by id in `[0xadadfc]`, statistics at +8, the club's row via 0x4a4850): the first of more than 1 match whose last one was less than 10 days ago (0x54cdb0 from the match date), in the order +0x19 (type 1, date +0x25), +0x2d (3, +0x39), +0x55 (4, +0x61) and +0x41 (2, +0x4d): the type and the length (byte). None (or without league, competition, statistics or row): type 5 and length 0. `this` is not used.

On a one-in-four random draw, posts the 0x1776 news of a rumour linking a manager with another club. \n SEH frame with no destructor. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_job_rumour_news(person, club)`: without a person or without their club (+0x39), nothing; a random(4) = 0, nothing; before the news date (`[0xdd6ec8]`), nothing. News 0x1776 (local): 0..3 the person, 4 = the job (+0x3d), 5 = the id of their club, 6 = the id of the rumoured club, 7 = random(4); to the recipients (0x8d1da0 of the transfer manager `[0xde1f54]`, with 0x52, up to 30; without a manager, none) through the delivery to the manager (0x7861e0).

Returns statistic `qual` 1..22 of the record (bytes, percentages ×100.0f, per-match averages, the two ratings completed with under 20 matches ×0.05f), in x87 like the original. \n Statistic `qual` of record `r` (matches at +0, bytes +2..+0xd, words +0xe..+0x1a, +0x1c integer), as the original leaves it in x87: 1..12 the bytes; 13 and 16 the percentages (+0x12/+0x10 and +0x1a/+0x18, times 100.0f); 14, 15, 17 and 21 the per-match averages; 18 the average of +0xe with fewer than 20 matches completed by `peso` (weight; times 0.05f); 20 the rating (2×+9 − +0xa + matches, completed by 1.5 with fewer than 20 matches; 1.5f with no matches); 22 the integer. No divisor: 0.0. Null `r`, 19 or outside 1..22: the original (error box).

Returns the average of the record's five 4-bit ratings (zero counts as 27), 16-bit, divided by 4. \n The average of the five 4-bit ratings of record `*indice` (0x27 bytes each, starting at `[this+0x30]`): the two halves of +0x24 and of +0x25 and the low half of +0x26, each ×4 (zero counts as 27), summed in 16 bits and divided by 4 (truncating). Null `indice`: the original (error box).

When the player leaves a club: the season's stats of each category go to the history file (with the year, the club, the fee and the kind of exit) and are cleared; an empty node when the last category is missing; and the games and goals for the club are recounted from the history. \n `PlayerStats::archive_player_stats(person, fee, loan, end, club, other)`, called from club exits (contracts 0x4c7ac0/0x4cbd20/0x4d01e0/0x4d07e0, 0x690730 the squad, 0x7c1350 the national teams). The node type: 2 with `loan`, 1 with `end`, 3 with `other`, otherwise 0. Null person: the error box (line 0xf28) and 0; without a record: 0. Each of the six categories with a record (the record's 39-byte entry in `[this+0x30]`) goes to the history (the current year and club, the record's 32 bytes in `[this+4]`, `fee`, the category and the type) and the record is cleared. Without the sixth category, an empty category 6 node with `fee` when: `fee` ≥ 0 or `end`; or `club` ≥ 0 and: outside the season of the club's nation (table 0xb63d8a); or, without the nation or in its season, less than 365 days since joining the club (+0x3e/+0x42, 0x54cdb0). With `club` ≥ 0 or `fee` ≥ 0: the games (+0x20) and goals (+0x22) for `club` are recounted from the category 2 nodes of the history (0x58f120). Returns 1.

Builds the player's career table, six entries (categories) per season and club: the current season, then those from the history file from newest to oldest with the empty years filled, the repeated entries of the same season and club summed and the empty groups removed. \n `PlayerStats::build_career_history(person, &count)`: the table (malloc 0x944e46 of 500 entries, realloc 0x945667 in steps of 500; the caller frees it with 0x9452ca) with six entries per season and club, and the count in `*count`. Null person (line 0xb98) or without a record (0xbaa): the error box and 0; id from `[0xae2364]` on: 0; out of memory: the error box (0xbb2, 0xc00, 0xc26, 0xc41) and 0. \n (1) The current season: the six categories with the year of the club's season (0x669950), the club (+0x39; −1 without one), transfer −1 and the category's 32 bytes (0x7c3920) when present. (2) The history from the file (FILE_LLIST::get_nodes 0x58f120 of `[this]` by the positions +0x18/+0x1c of the record's 0x27-byte entry in `[this+0x30]`), from end to start (0x68d1d0): each node of another season, club or type opens a group: the count moves on by 6; empty years between the two (until the count exceeds 500) become empty groups (club −1, transfer −1); the node's group takes the year, the club, the transfer and the node's type; the node goes into the entry for its category (+0x2a / 8) in the group. The list is destroyed (0x68d040 and 0x944c94). (3) The count moves on by 6; each entry takes the transfer and the type of the entry six ahead (those of the last group, −1 and 0). (4) A group followed by one of the same year and club, with no transfer in either, the following one's type other than 1 and the word +0x14 other than −1 in both, adds bytes +6..+0x13 and the word +0x14 into the following one and disappears (year 0). (5) A group without matches (+6, +7 of the first and the last entry), with a year, without a transfer and of type 0 disappears when it has no club or when another group has its year and the next group is of the same club; one with matches whose last entry has no club (+0xd9) also disappears. (6) The year-0 groups leave the table (the following ones move down) and the count drops by 6 per group.

Returns how many years since the person played for the club: 0 when they are there, −1 when never. \n `player_stats_years_since_at_club(person, club)`: how many years since the person played for the club: 0 if they are in it (+0x39), −1 if never; otherwise today's year (0xae2c92) minus the highest year among the history groups (0x7c3e40 on `[0xb74350]`; the last entry of each group, +0xd7 the year, +0xd9 the club) with the club. Null person (line 0x133f), null club (0x1347) or without a record (0x135f): the error box and −1; id from `[0xae2364]` on: −1. The caller calls it with the PlayerStats in ecx, which it does not use. Called from 0x5b03e0 (does not run in the automatic career: it passes through untested).

The qsort order of the history records: by person, by year and by the first field. \n `player_stats_compare_history_by_staff(a, b)`, the qsort order of the staff_history.dat records when the statistics are created (0x7bfd50, pointer at 0x7c05ad): null `a` 1, null `b` −1; by person (+4, unsigned), then by year (+8, signed word), then the difference of the first dword.

Returns the requested statistic of the category record (without a record, the default for the rating and the average), or the combined ratings of categories 2 to 5. \n `PlayerStats::get_stat(player, category, qual, default)`, as the original leaves it in x87. No player: the "Error" box (line 0x659) and 0.0; id (+0) outside the table (`[0xae236c]`): 0.0. With `qual` ≠ 0x13 and the category (signed byte) up to 6: the category record (0x7c3920) gives the statistic (0x7c2150 with `qual` and `default`); without a record, `default` for 0x12 and 0x14 and 0.0 for the others. Otherwise the combined ratings from categories 2+3 (matches n and total t of +0xe: n < 20, ((20 − n)·5 + t)·0.05f; otherwise t/n; stored as f32), 4 (n < 8, ((8 − n)·3 + t)·0.125; otherwise t/n; f32) and 5 (n < 5, ((5 − n) + t)·0.2f; otherwise t/n; in x87): category 100, (c5·1.5 + c4·2.5 + c23·6)·0.1; 101, (c5·3 + c4·5 + 2·c23)·0.1; 102, (c5·5 + c4·4 + c23)·0.1; the others 0.0. Without record 4 or 5 the original reads uninitialised locals (the copy uses zero; the comparer leaves those cases to the original). Called from the line-up choice 0x6e2f20, MATCH_PLAYER::setup 0x6eaea0, the club reputation 0x545e90, the player strength 0x546ab0, the staff's daily pass 0x5ce2d0 and others. Hot: no counter.

The order of the language records: by person id and by language, with 0xff matching any language. \n `player_stats_compare_language_entries(a, b)` (the qsort and bsearch of the languages, 6-byte records {id, language, fluency}): null a, −1; null b, 1; different ids (+0), the difference; language 0xff in either one, 0; otherwise the difference of the languages (+4, signed). Used by the language fluency 0x7c6830 and by the languages added, removed and improved.

Sums the goals of every season and club of the player's career table (0x7c3e40), in 16 bits. \n The original receives the PlayerStats in ecx and does not read it. `player_stats_get_career_goals(person)` (called from MATCH_PLAYER::setup 0x6eaea0, which writes it into +0x43 of the match player): null person, the "Error" box (line 0xb4b) and 0; id from `[0xae2364]` on, 0; without the player record (+0x61), the error box (line 0xb5d) and 0. Otherwise the career table (0x7c3e40 of `[0xb74350]`: 0x2b-byte entries, six per season and club) and the sum, in 16 bits, of byte +8 of the sixth entry of each group (+0xdf); the table is freed (0x9452ca, also when null). Hot (every player of every match): no counter.

Returns the 0x20-byte record of the player's category (1..6), through the index in the 39-byte entry of his id; 0 without an index. \n `PlayerStats::get_category_record(player, category)`: the 0x20-byte record (`[this+4]` + 32 × index) of the player's category (category_slot), or 0 when the index is −1 or lower. No player or outside 1..6: the "Error" box and 0: the original. Called from PlayerStats::record_match 0x7c10e6 and PlayerStats::get_stat 0x7c1e30 (the match engine's averages). Hot: no counter.

Returns the player's category record; without an index, the first free record (+0xe = 0xffff) or a new one at the end (grows by 100), zeroed. \n `PlayerStats::create_stats(player, category)`: the player's category record (category_slot); without an index (−1), with loose records (`[this+0x38]`), the first record of `[this+4]` (count +0xc) with +0xe = 0xffff becomes his (cleared; the loose count goes down); otherwise one at the end (cleared; the count goes up): when full (capacity +8), it grows in steps of 100 (realloc 0x945667; out of memory, the error box 0xef4 and 0). No player or outside 1..6: the "Error" box and 0: the original. Called from PlayerStats::record_match 0x7c10f9.

Appends the new entry to the language table (6 bytes: id, language, fluency up to 10; starts at 100, grows by 100) and sorts it when asked (qsort). \n `PlayerStats::add_language(person, language, fluency, sort)`: the language table (6 bytes per record in `[this+0x3c]`, capacity +0x40, count +0x44) starts with 100 (malloc 0x258) and grows by 100 (realloc) when full; the new record at the end: the person's id, the language and the fluency (at most 10, signed); with `sort`, qsort with the comparison 0x7c6d40. Out of memory: fatal error box.

Returns from 0 to 10 how well the person speaks the language: the contract level, 10 for a nation (or the second one) speaking the language, or the learned language (binary search). \n `PlayerStats::get_language_fluency(person, club, language, by_contract)`: how well the person speaks `language` (0 to 10). Human manager (id ≥ `[0xae2364]`): 10 if it is the language (+0x77) of their nation (+0x1a), otherwise 0. With `by_contract`, the contract with the club (0x4cf5f0) of someone playing at a club (+0x39) of the same nation as `club` (+0x53): the contract level (+0x4f & 0xf). 10 if the nation (+0x1a) or the second one (+0x1e) speaks the language of `club`'s nation or `language`. Otherwise the learned language: the binary search (bsearch 0x946464, comparison 0x7c6d40, 6-byte records at `[+0x3c]`, `[+0x44]` of them) for the key {id, language}, byte +5; without the table or the record, 0. The callers read only `al`.

Records a match in the statistics: by each side's category (friendly, reserves, competition type; a random draw in a simulated match), adds the rating and the match to the double sums and each player who played to the category records (games, goals, score, rating, minutes...), to the player's games and goals and to contract +0x3b; shifts the form by half a byte. \n `PlayerStats::record_match(fixture, match)`: null fixture or match, the error boxes and 0. Competition −2 (simulated match): the category is random(9) ≠ 0 ? 2 : 3 for both sides; otherwise each side's own (match_stats_category). In each row that counts (match_lineup_row): the rating (+0x35) and one match into the double sums of `this` (+0x20/+0x28 with the match's flag +0x4c, otherwise +0x10/+0x18); into the 0x20-byte category records (0x7c3920, or created by 0x7c5d80): matches, appearances, goals/assists and the rest of the row (+0x21..+0x2d), goals for (the side's +0x11f) and against (+0x744 − side), win and defeat, man of the match (+0x3c), the words (+0x35, +0x3e, +0x3f, +0x42, +0x28, +0x25, +0x26) and the minutes (+0x34, +0x30 or the match duration +0x4d; a substitute subtracts the entry time +0x32). In category 2 or with the competition counting (0x4b0700): +1 match and the goals in the player's record (`[this+0x30]`, 0x27 bytes) and, without a record (0x4cf6d0), +1 on the contract's +0x3b (0x4cf5a0). Finally the form (+0x24..+0x26) shifts by half a byte and receives the rating. Returns 1.

For the nation's clubs (up to the first national team), archives (0x7c5fe0) the statistics of every squad player not on loan elsewhere; 1 (0 and the "Error" box without a nation). \n `PlayerStats::end_season_for_key_nation(nation)`: without a nation, the "Error" box at line 0x396 and 0. Walks the clubs of `[0xae235c]` up to the first national team (0x53b900: it stops there); a club of the nation (0x669360, 72-byte record at 0xb63d60): each player (+0x61, id below `[0xae2364]`) of the 50 slots (+0xd7) without a loan (0x4cf6d0 on `[0xae1050]`) or on loan to the club itself (+0x39) has his statistics archived (0x7c5fe0 with −1, 0, 0, −1, 0). Returns 1.

Removes a language from the player's language table (binary search) and shifts the later entries down. \n Removes language `idioma` of player `ficha` from the language table (`[this+0x3c]`, `[this+0x44]` entries of 6 bytes: id, language, fluency), found by binary search (0x946464 with 0x7c6d40): the following entries move down one place, the last one becomes id −1 and language 0, and the count drops. Without a table or without the entry: nothing.

Returns the player's league appearances (field 1) or league goals (field 2) at the club, as a float. \n The player's league statistic at the club, as a float (fild): field 1 the matches (word +0x20) and field 2 the goals (word +0x22) of the 39-byte record at `[this+0x30]` + id × 39. Null player or any other field: the original (error box).

Returns the player's last match rating (6.5 with none). \n The last match rating of player `*id` (the low 4 bits of byte +0x26 of the 39-byte record at `[estatisticas+0x30]`, the statistics); with no rating, 6.5 (`[0x96e2b8]`). Null player: the original (error box). Returns in st0.

Sums the goals of the player's seasons for the club in the career table (0x7c3e40), in 16 bits. \n The original receives the PlayerStats in ecx and does not read it. `player_stats_get_goals_for_club(person, club)` (called from MATCH_PLAYER::setup 0x6eaea0, which writes it into +0x3d of the match player): null person, the "Error" box (line 0xb04) and 0; null club, the one at line 0xb0c and 0; id from `[0xae2364]` on, 0; without the player record (+0x61), the one at line 0xb1e and 0. Otherwise the career table (0x7c3e40 of `[0xb74350]`: 0x2b-byte entries, six per season and club) and the sum, in 16 bits, of byte +0xdf of the groups whose club (+0xd9, signed, non-negative) is the id of `club`; the table is freed (0x9452ca, also when null). Hot (every player of every match): no counter.

Returns the competition weight by the club's two competitions (500/1000/300/100). \n The weight of competition `cod` for player `p` by the club's two competitions (+0x1a and +0x1e): in the four special competitions (`[0x9cf4a8]` with 0x16/0x20, `[0x9cf408]` with 0x1e/0x20, `[0x9cf2c0]` with 0x16/0x1e, `[0x9cf244]` with 7) and in the competition's codes +0x78/+0x79: 500/1000/500/300 by the first, 300/500/300/100 by the second; no competition, 0. The desired contract (0x85fc50 into a local contract, with the contract's club, −1, the status and 0xb) and the ratio 100 × value of the current contract (0x866830, as f32) / value of the desired one (zero value: ratio 0). More than one player from another club in the squad (the 50 slots at +0xd7, counted only with the player's id below `[0xae2364]`): 0x26.
